SHARED-B-M1-S1.title: Tool Schema and Validation Contract
SHARED-B-M1-S1.description: Define Pydantic schemas for all allowlisted tools with strict input models, required/optional fields, defaults, and standardized 422 validation errors with field-level detail. Schemas must align exactly with Anthropic tool_use structure (name + JSON input payload) and existing tool_models modules.

SHARED-B-M1-S2.title: Allowlist-Based Tool Routing Logic
SHARED-B-M1-S2.description: Implement routing engine enforcing explicit config-driven allowlist (centralized mapping of tool_name → schema → handler), strict schema-to-tool binding, input validation via Pydantic, payload normalization, and rejection of unknown tools. Emit structured debug logs (tool name, validation outcome, latency, rejection reason). Provide deterministic error taxonomy (validation_error, unknown_tool, execution_error) and normalized response envelope for all outcomes.

SHARED-B-M1-S3.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
SHARED-B-M1-S3.description: Implement controlled chat history injection with token-aware truncation aligned to Anthropic context limits, prioritizing most recent messages, enforcing role filtering (user/assistant/system), and guaranteeing deterministic ordering prior to tool execution.

SHARED-B-M1-S4.title: Tool Router API Integration with Main Loop
SHARED-B-M1-S4.description: Integrate router into FastAPI main loop: parse Anthropic tool_use blocks, invoke routing, enforce timeouts, handle malformed payloads gracefully, and normalize outputs (including errors) into Anthropic-compatible tool_result blocks to maintain agent loop continuity. Must not introduce new API surfaces beyond existing main.py loop.
